# ASK Security

> Independent security audits for web3 protocols, infrastructure, and wallets.

## Services

- [Code Audit](https://asksecurity.xyz/#services): review of smart contracts and off-chain infrastructure (Solidity, Vyper, Rust, zk-circuits).
- [Infrastructure Audit](https://asksecurity.xyz/#services): nodes, validators, bridges, and cloud infrastructure.
- [Security Research](https://asksecurity.xyz/#services): research on new mechanisms and primitives.
- [Continuous Security Monitoring](https://asksecurity.xyz/#services): real-time alerts on deployed contracts and support.
